title: DynaCoil
description:
DYNACOIL
The DynaCoil truly turns any vapcap into a concentrate consuming beast.
The DynaCoil is constructed out of medical grade titanium and is designed to effectively soak up various types of concentrate.
Like all DynaVap products a lot of thought has gone into the design of the DynaCoil. If you look closely at the top of the coil you will see that it is made up of a number of teeth that slope inwards towards the centre. This helps the application of sticky concentrates as the teeth grab onto it and help remove it from what ever tool you might be using.
Please note the DynaCoil does not currently come with container.
Included
1 x DynaCoil
